articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 44/2025

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Mohli bychom k přenosu informace využívat gravitační vlny? Vědci se prý přiblížili přímým důkazům temné hmoty. ELI překročilo hranici 5 petawattů s laserovým systémem L4 ATON. Výdaje na výzkum a vývoj ve vztahu k HDP stagnují.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Quantum Echoes - Google ukázal další příklad nadřazenosti na kvantovém počítači

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: České firmy AI rychle adoptují, ale zůstávají u základních funkcí. AWS Cloud Day Prague 2025: Amazon vsadil na umělou inteligenci a evropskou datovou suverenitu. Mzdový vývoj v IT: nároky rostou, mzdy nikoli. Hlad po specialistech trvá, juniorských pozic ubývá. Digitální suverenita nestojí na ideálech, ale na konkrétních výsledcích. Nová čtyřprvková polovodičová slitina slibuje pokročilejší čipy. Pure Storage mění přístup ke kybernetické odolnosti. Red Hat AI 3 přináší distribuované odvozování AI do produkčních úloh. HPE a Ericsson nabídnou ověření duálního řešení sítí 5G.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Nová čtyřprvková polovodičová slitina slibuje pokročilejší čipy

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 43/2025

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Jak vhodné jsou pro život hyceánské světy? Poprvé pozorovali dvojici černých děr na společné oběžné dráze. Nový světový rekord v rychlosti sekvenování celého lidského genomu. Nový přepínač mezi supravodičem, izolátorem a zvláštním kvantovým mezistavem.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Hacking pošty v době předinternetové

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Windows 11 CDkey na Halloween od Goodoffer24 jen za €20.00 a strašidelně nízké ceny i za další software, jako například Windows 11 Home Professional od Goodoffer24.com a budete připraveni s novým operačním systémem na další práci bez obav. Na Goodoffer24 totiž můžete koupit také hry nebo aplikace Office.
articles.title: Neděste se upgradu: Windows 11 Pro na Halloween jen za €20.00 na Goodoffer24

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Epson EcoTank L6370: Tank pro kancelář i domácnost s mimořádně levným provozem. Zebra v Praze ukázala AI dvojníky i vzdělávání s virtuální realitou. Data se ztrácí čím dál více, navzdory chytřejším postupům a rekordním výdajům na bezpečnost. Útočníci nevyvíjejí nové metody, ale zdokonalují ty stávající. Agentní AI v prohlížečích: nová vrstva bezpečnostních rizik pro podniky. AWS Cloud Day Prague 2025: Technologická událost roku se vrací s důrazem na využití generativní AI v praxi. Co pro firmy znamená konec podpory Windows 10. AI nyní nahrazuje především mladé a vzdělané – možná. SAP ukázal, jak propojuje AI, data a aplikace.

articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Jak souvisí krystaly křemíku s kosmickými strunami?

articles.author: karkar
articles.description: Po dvaceti letech skončil leader japonské SUMO (SUpport.MOzilla.org) komunity Marsf. Důvodem bylo nasazení sumobota, který nedodržuje nastavené postupy a hrubě zasahuje do překladů i archivů. Marsf zároveň zakázal použití svých příspěvků a dat k učení sumobota a AI a požádal o vyřazení svých dat ze všech učebních dat.
articles.title: Konec japonské SUMO komunity

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Úřad pro ochranu hospodářské soutěže zahajuje sektorové šetření v oblasti mobilních telekomunikačních služeb poskytovaných domácnostem v České republice. Z poznatků získaných na základě prvotní analýzy provedené ve spolupráci s Českým telekomunikačním úřadem (ČTÚ) ÚOHS zjistil, že vzájemné vztahy mezi operátory je zapotřebí detailněji prověřit kvůli možné nefunkčnosti některých aspektů konkurence na trzích, na nichž roste tržní podíl klíčových hráčů a naopak klesá význam nezávislých virtuálních operátorů.
articles.title: ÚOHS prověří fungování hospodářské soutěže v oblasti mobilních služeb

articles.description:
The Roots update in PEAK has added mushrooms of all types, and you can even jump on some of them to travel across the biome. 


While mushrooms in the Roots biome have different uses (some are pretty dangerous for your health), you can also use them to guide your movement. If you're in the mood for some high-flying action, you can jump off them and try to bounce at least 40m in the air to earn the Mycoacrobatics badge.


How to obtain the Mycoacrobatics badge in PEAK


There are different ways of obtaining this badge, but the requirement is always the same: jump at least 40m off the ground from a mushroom. The easiest way to complete the objective is by using Bounce Fungus.


When you pick up this mushroom, it shrinks in size. Plant it in the ground, and it will grow back. Make sure to place it in a location with an open clearing. This will let you jump high enough.


Image via Aggro Crab


To hit the 40m mark, you'll have to select a point from where you're going to jump on the Bounce Fungus. This point needs to be as high as possible from where the fungus is. The greater the distance, the higher the jump. That said, you should be careful not to land outside the Bounce Fungus, as you can take fall damage and even die in the process. 


You can do the same with other mushrooms that spawn in Roots. However, you won't get a similar height on your jump, which makes it hard to obtain the Mycoacrobatics badge. Of course, you can also consume certain mushrooms to unlock new in-game effects. The Shroomberries, a brand-new addition, have random effects that rotate daily. You can consume all five of them on the same run to unlock the Advanced Mycology badge.

articles.author: Scott Duwe
articles.description:
At 12 years and counting, it's felt like a lifetime. But the wait for Grand Theft Auto 6 just got even longer.


To the surprise of few, GTA 6 has been pushed out of its release date of May 26, 2026, and will now launch just about six months later. Rockstar Games made the unfortunate announcement on X/Twitter today.




"We are sorry for adding additional time to what we realize has been a long wait, but these extra months will allow us to finish the game with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve," the company said.


GTA 6 will now launch just over one year from now on Nov. 19, 2026, potentially pitting it against games like Call of Duty and other fall/winter releases. But given the anticipation and excitement for this long-awaited sequel, it's likely that we will see other games push their release dates to avoid it soon.


"We want to thank you again for your patience and support," Rockstar said. "While the wait is a little longer, we are incredibly excited for players to experience the sprawling state of Leonida and a return to modern day Vice City."


This is the second time GTA 6 has suffered an official delay. It was initially supposed to launch in 2025, but was pushed to next May to allow for more development time and polish. 


Given the assumed scale and reported development cost of the game (over $2 billion), it makes sense for Rockstar to make sure that this game launches in a proper state, even though it could probably be broken upon release and still break records. And so for that, I respect the delay and wish the devs the best in making this game as good as it possibly can be, because the expectations are probably insurmountable.

The post GTA 6 just got delayed again. For real. And so the long wait continues appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: GTA 6 just got delayed again. For real. And so the long wait continues

articles.author: Andrej Barovic
articles.description:
Crossplay is one of the greatest innovations in gaming, bridging the gap between various proprietary platforms and allowing players to venture out together no matter their device. 


But in first-person shooters, some simply do not like it, especially PC players. Aim assist and various other advantages afforded to console players to "even the playing field" tend to go a little overboard, making the controller superior to mouse and keyboard.


Thankfully, the PC is home to mods and tinkering, so if you want to disable crossplay, here is how you can do so.


How to disable crossplay in Battlefield 6 (PC only) 


Crossplay is fun, but tends to be overtuned in FPS games. Screenshot by Battlefield Studios


While there is no button to turn crossplay off in Battlefield 6, unlike in many other shooters these days, it can still be done, and all it takes is some text file editing in the game's installation directory. 


To disable crossplay, follow these steps: 



Navigate to Documents/Battlefield 6/settings/steam and open the PROFSAVE_profile file with Notepad. 


At the very bottom of the list, add the following command: GstGameplay.CrossPlayEnable 0. 


Save the file and exit. 



And that's it; the next time you fire the game up, you will only be matched with players on PC, with no console users in sight. This should also only apply to the official queue, as Portal has its own user-set rules that may or may not allow various controller-based advantages such as aim assist. Therefore, if you don't want to go through the hassle of disabling crossplay, merely find a Portal server that did it for you.

The post How to turn off crossplay in Battlefield 6 appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: How to turn off crossplay in Battlefield 6

Upgrading your workshop is one of the most important goals for any raider in ARC Raiders, and getting to some of those top levels is going to take a lot of effort. 


One item that is necessary for these industrial expansions is the Rusted Gear, and exceedingly rare component that can only be found out in the world. But some locations tend to have better odds of dropping it, so here's where you should go to get yourself a few of these items. 


How to find Rusted Gear in ARC Raiders


The Scrap Yard is a good early spot to check for Rusted Gears if you don't want to risk it on The Blue Gate. Screenshot by Destructoid


Rusted Gear is a random drop that can be found in just about any container in the game. However, Industrial zones tend to have greater odds of spawning it, as do specific types of containers such as cars, whose hoods have a small but non-zero chance to give one of this item. 


The best overall locations for finding Rusted Gears would be the Warehouse Complex in Blue Gate, specifically its underground sections that have tons of cars to search through. Hoods seem to have the best odds, but any searchable container is worth checking, given that the item is so rare that you could very well look through hundreds of cars without finding it.


Additionally, the Scrap Yard in Dam Battlegrounds has tons of car wreckages and other Industrial stashes that, like the Complex, could spawn Rusted Gears. Again, the odds are super small, so check every single container that you come across to maximize your odds. 


You should also always bring a proper Augment that has Safe Pockets to ensure you don't die and lose an item that took you several runs to find.

ARCs are not just your enemies: they are a valuable source of high-tier items that are necessary to keep this little underground project of ours going. 


We humans have a symbiotic relationship with these machines, and exterminating them completely wouldn't be advisable. One items that the people of Speranza need are the Snitch Scanners, required for numerous crucial upgrades, much like other ARC parts like Hornet Drivers, for example.


If you were on the lookout for some of these, here's what you should do. 


Where to get Snitch Scanner in ARC Raiders


You can summon ARCs with the Scanner to give your enemies extra things to worry about. Screenshot by Destructoid


Snitch Scanners are, as the name implies, dropped by Snitches, the circular ARC that constantly scans for new threats and then calls in three more ARCs from orbit to help it out if it turns hostile. It's always flying around the map looking for trouble, though I've noticed many more of them on Buried City than on any other map.


To get the Scanners, simply attack the Snitch and take it down, then loot its chassis. You might also discover husks and remains around the maps that should drop Scanners as well. 


The best way to kill a Snitch is to bring it down before it calls in any reinforcements, and to do that shoot at its "wings." It has three separate segments, each having some sort of "lightbulb" attached, and destroying two will send the thing flying to its doom super quickly. If you want to farm some extra ARC materials, though, let it call in the reinforcements and take them all down together. 


The supports are usually two Wasps and a Hornet, which isn't the strongest bunch.

Interact with the bag and the flag will drop out. Pick it up, then turn to your left and walk out onto the ledge to the east where you can find a flagpole. Interact with that, seen here below, to attach the flag to the pole and fly it high:

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In a submission for the 2026 National Trade Estimate Report, Cloudflare warns the U.S. government that site blocking efforts cause widespread disruption to legitimate services. The complaint points to Italy's automated Piracy Shield system, which reportedly blocked "tens of thousands" of legitimate sites. Meanwhile, overbroad IP address blocks in Spain and new automated blocking proposals in France are serious concerns that harm U.S. business interests, Cloudflare reports.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare Tells U.S. Govt That Foreign Site Blocking Efforts Are Digital Trade Barriers

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Early September, a massive law enforcement operation in Argentina targeted a global IPTV piracy network's business in Latin America. The aim was to shut down dozens of branded services including My Family Cinema, TV Express and Eppi Cinema, that were being targeted at the Brazilian market. With surprisingly few concerns that reliability of IPTV services could nosedive, last weekend that's exactly what happened in Brazil. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Empire Goes Dark in Brazil, Marketing the Common Denominator

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Popular shadow library Anna's Archive has become a top target for copyright holders. In just three years, publishers and authors have prompted Google to remove 749 million of the site's URLs from its search results. Despite this immense takedown campaign, which accounts for 5% of all URLs reported to Google on copyright grounds, the site itself remains easily discoverable through the search engine.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Google Removed 749 Million Anna’s Archive URLs from its Search Results

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Warner Bros. Discovery Sports and TNT Sports are the latest sports rightsholders to request a pirate site blocking injunction at the High Court in London. The specific content the companies aim to protect isn't clear but with football, rugby, MotoGP, UFC, boxing and more to choose from, there's no shortage of options. For UK consumers looking for choice, the opposite seems to be true.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Warner Bros. Discovery & TNT Sports Target UK Piracy Blocking Injunction

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'The Long Walk' tops the chart, followed by 'The Fantastic Four: First Steps'. 'Tron: Ares' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 11/03/2025

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Religion has two faces; that's also true when it comes to online piracy, albeit with a twist. A new academic study has found that those who use religion mostly for social benefits are more likely to pirate than those with strongly internalized religious beliefs. It also pinpoints the mental gymnastics pirates have to use to justify their actions.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Some Pirates Use Religion as an Excuse, For Others It’s a Moral Barrier

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A Pennsylvania man, alleged to be the operator of several pirate IPTV services including 'Shrugs' and 'Zing', faces a potential $9 million default judgment. After major Hollywood studios sued him in March, the defendant was personally served but failed to respond or appear in court. The studios also seek a permanent injunction to take over the associated domain names and cut off its hosting services. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Pirate IPTV Operator Faces $9 Million in Damages After Ghosting Hollywood Lawsuit

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A huge coalition of rightsholders with collective revenues running to hundreds of billions of euros, is demanding legislative action to tackle live event piracy in the EU. In a letter to the European Commission, major rightsholders and broadcasters demand three legislative measures. They represent new burdens and liabilities for intermediaries, a potential disaster for privacy-first VPN providers, and risk undermining privacy and security for everyone in EU member states.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: IPTV Anti-Piracy Demands Are Bad For ISPs, Spell Disaster for User Privacy & Security

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Nintendo has secured a final default judgment against Jesse Keighin, aka 'EveryGameGuru'. The gaming giant sued Keighin in 2024 after he streamed pirated copies of pre-release games. In correspondence with Nintendo's legal team, Keighin was initially defiant, but failed to defend the case against him. A Colorado federal court has now ordered the streamer to pay $17,500 in damages but refused to issue an injunction against unnamed "third parties" or order the "destruction" of circumvention devices.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Wins Lawsuit Against Defiant ‘Pirate’ Streamer ‘EveryGameGuru’

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A powerful injunction obtained by members of the MPA, anti-piracy coalition ACE, and Korea-based anti-piracy group COA, has launched its first follow-up attack after targeting 248 domains in September. In this wave, the numbers are significantly smaller, with around a dozen domains listed for blocking and suspension. However, by aggressively targeting VidSrc, a site upon which many other sites have come to rely, the domino effect could've been significant.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Global Piracy Injunction Targets VidSrc Domains, Hydra Regenerates in Russia

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Meta is using a classic BitTorrent defense in its legal battle with adult film producer Strike 3 Holdings. In its motion to dismiss, the tech company argues that IP-address evidence is insufficient to prove who the infringer is. Meta further counters that the "sporadic" downloads on its corporate network began years before its relevant AI research started. Instead of AI training, Meta argues the activity was likely just for "private personal use"
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta: Pirated Adult Film Downloads Were For “Personal Use,” Not AI Training

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Supreme Court battle over a $1 billion piracy judgment against internet provider Cox Communications is one of the decade's pivotal copyright lawsuits. After the ISP received broad support, including from the U.S. Government, a diverse group of amici have now weighed in to support the music labels. This includes the MPA, former members of Congress, the U.S. Copyright Office, as well as the National Center on Sexual Exploitation.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Broad Coalition Backs Record Labels in Supreme Court ISP Piracy Liability Battle

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A lawsuit filed last November by DISH and Sling TV targeted Richard Moy and CLVPN LLC. It was alleged that Moy illegally gained access to the companies' servers and redistributed their TV content to 450,000 users. To mitigate customer concerns that his pirate IPTV service might be unlawful, Moy allegedly claimed law enforcement affiliation. Unable to pay his attorney in August, Moy has just agreed to settle the lawsuit for a "conservative" $44.5 million.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Man Settles Lawsuit For $44.5m Yet Couldn’t Pay His Attorney

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
History has shown that if the source of pirated content isn't eliminated, one way or another it will simply reappear somewhere else. Targeting consumer-facing streaming sites does cause disruption, but not as much as targeting the supplier of their streams. Or targeting that supplier's supplier and then hitting the supplier above them. Effective in theory, perhaps, but in the world of 'CDN leeching', pirate streams and legal streams share the same supplier.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: The Streaming Piracy Crisis Suppressant That Nobody Wants To Discuss

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A proposal calling for the Spanish government to protect innocent websites from pirate site overblocking has been rejected. The proposal before the Congressional Committee on Economy, Trade, and Digital Transformation, recognized that football league LaLiga needs to protect its rights, but said safeguards are necessary after the wrongful blocking of thousands of third-party websites.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Proposal to Prevent LaLiga Site-Blocking Hurting Innocent Sites Rejected in Spain

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
European football's governing body, UEFA, has joined global anti-piracy coalition ACE. The move will help the Champions League organizer to more effectively tackle live streaming piracy. While sports piracy is a growing problem, UEFA has also seen a spectacular increase in revenues. This has resulted in costly, fragmented subscriptions for fans, which some see as a primary driver for the very piracy UEFA is trying to defeat.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: UEFA Joins Anti-Piracy Coalition ACE to Protect Growing Revenues from Piracy Surge

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In the modern piracy ecosystem, sites and domains have become disposable, but "brands" often survive. This phenomenon is highlighted by the MPA's latest DMCA subpoena request, which hunts the "ghosts" of already defeated operations. On behalf of ACE, the MPA requests Cloudflare and the .to registry hand over identifying data for 46 domains. The list includes domains linked to notorious "zombie" brands, including FMovies, Aniwave, and 123movies, as well as new "hydra" sites like Nunflix.org.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MPA Targets ‘Zombie’ Pirate Brands Including Fmovies, Cuevana and Aniwave

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A decision by Canal+ to target public DNS resolvers to reinforce pirate site blocking, ended with a French court ordering Cloudflare and Google to deny access to list of streaming sites. A lawyer who acted for Canal+ says that led to measurable progress, despite Cloudflare reportedly making "independent decisions" on which sites to block or not. In the political arena, the U.S. govt. has ordered diplomats to oppose EU law that obliges intermediaries to cooperate with rightsholders.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare ‘Resists’ Piracy Blocks, U.S. Govt. Opposes EU Co-Op Obligations

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every year, the Office of the United States Trade Representative uses input from copyright holders to update its list of notorious piracy markets. The process aims to help combat copyright infringement, but for the past several years, recurring arguments and rebuttals have contributed to a 'Groundhog Day' loop. Recent submissions also reveal various 'copy-paste' efforts, highlighting a persistent standoff between rightsholders and accused parties like Cloudflare.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anti-Piracy Groundhog Day: Recycled Arguments Plague USTR’s Notorious Markets Review

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (DreamMaster)
articles.description:
A kingdom in turmoil. Twin princesses kidnapped. And it's up to two intrepid heroes, Hodj and Podj, to compete in a gauntlet of minigames in order to rescue the princesses and escort them back to safety. The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce full support for Hodj 'n' Podj. This is the other Boffo Game that shared the Bagel engine with The Space Bar.
Special thanks go out to the folks at ZOOM Platform for supporting us in adding this game.
Help us test the game by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. And please take some screenshots along the way.
You can challenge the boardgame, run through all the minigames using the Grand Tour, or pick and choose specific minigames to play. Put your skills to the test, with either a one or two player experience, and find out who the true Hodj 'n' Podj champion is.
>

articles.description: Je to nechutné, zábavné a občas to nakousavá nějaká hlubší témata. Připomnělo mi to starší filmy Davida Cronenberga, ve kterých byl mladý, neklidný a vtipný (pokud jste měli hodně vyšinutý smysl pro humor). Hezky to šlape, není tam nic zbytečného navíc a je to dobrý příklad toho, že můžete natočit dobře fungující film za relativně málo peněz. (Ilča 80 %)

articles.description: Výborný dvacetiminutový film o Keanu Reevesovi v roli roztomilého anděla nekňuby, proložený 70 minutami něčeho úplně jiného, co většinou moc nefunguje a občas ani není jasné, kam to chce směřovat. Hlavní hrdina (nikoliv Reeves) je dost nevhodně obsazen, což je těžko řešitelný problém, protože je to současně režisér a producent tohoto filmu. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Boží úlet [Good Fortune] - 50 %

articles.description: Velmi standardní (a aspoň v mém případě VELMI předvídatelná) epizoda "Twilight Zone" nebo podobného seriálu, která má místo třiceti minut dvě hodiny, což jí činí velmi těžko stravitelnou. Na druhou stranu, z Lanthimosových filmů patří tato černá komedie k těm nejstravitelnějším pro širokou diváckou obec, což je dobře (pro širokou diváckou obec). (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Bugonia - 50 %

articles.title: Retro audio recenze: Pátý element [The Fifth Element] - 80%

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Vzhledem k tomu, že je to vlastně artfilm, jsem byl velmi potěšen tím, jak to všechno působivě vypadá (a zní). Ale to celkové WTF (prolínání víceúrovňových snů a podobenství) mi po dvou hodinách připadalo už poněkud nudné a postrádal jsem nějaký závěrečný klíč, s jehož pomocí by to do sebe všechno zapadlo. Čímž se "Mistr a Markétka" dost podobá filmům "Megalopolis" nebo "Brazil". (Ilča 90 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Mistr a Markétka [Мастер и Маргарита] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: První díl sice měl naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj, ale docela působivou retro atmosféru. Pokračování má také naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj (hodně připomínající libovolné pokračování "Noční můry v Elm Street"), ale velmi překvapivě (vzhledem ke stejnému režisérovi) mu chybí většina té působivé atmosféry, některé scény jsou nechtěně vtipné (strašidelné mrtvé děti za sklem) a film je delší, takže se všechno mnohem víc vleče. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Černý telefon 2 [Black Phone 2] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: "Pocitový" film s dobře fungující atmosférou a výbornými herci, kterému podráží nohy extrémní délka a extrémní pomalost všeho, co se v něm děje. Při třetím pomalém švenkování po stejné černobílé fotografii jsem zažíval téměř psychoteror a po 90 minutách jsem vážně uvažoval, že odejdu ze sálu. Námět je v mnoha ohledech podobný filmu "Hodiny" (2002), takže pokud vám ten připadal příliš komerční a přímočarý, "Pohled do slunce" zahraje na vaši artovou notu. (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Pohled do slunce [In die Sonne schauen] - 40 %

articles.description: Místy úderný videoklip s fajn vizuály a hudbou. Žádná z postav mě ale nezaujala. Scénář je velmi špatný, ignorující většinu potenciálně zajímavých zápletek a v různých ohledech odporující předchozím filmům, i když na ně výslovně odkazuje. Disney bohužel "zprznil" odkaz původního Trona podobně jako to udělal se Star Wars. (Ilča 50 %)
